full_judgment: 15. PW 1 Parimal Chandra in his deposition has retreated in the statement made in the petition and disclosed that others two petitioners are his brothers and uncle and the opposite party obtained the probate without any knowledge of the petitioner and the petitioner came to know the said case on 11-11-1985. He deposed that on perusal of the record of Other Case No. 45 of 1983 of the court of Assistant Judge, Kuliarchar, it is found that the petitioner was not a party of the said impugned probate case and no summons was served upon them. In cross-examination he disclosed that he does not know the extent of the property covered by the impugned He also disclosed that he has no knowledge about the plot No. and khatian number of the case land. In cross-examination he also admitted that Rajendra and Surendra the two sons of Gurucharan died during his life time and Gurucharan died leaving his one daughter and two daughters-in-law Sarala, Jamini and Kamini and also disclosed that Sarala was the daughter-in-law of Gurucharan and Guru-charan was the president of Saula Union under Kaliarchar. In cross examination he also disclosed that he paid the rent but did not file any rent receipt in the case.
